title: AI / Inference serving
description: Serving throughput, latency, queueing and loaded identity. Opens on the last 30 minutes and refreshes every second for live inference tuning (#653).

panels.title: Serving identity
panels.description: Labels identify the model, recipe, runtime and host on each successful scrape younger than ten seconds.

panels.title: Metrics reachable
panels.description: Successful inference metrics scrape younger than ten seconds, shown per serving host. This does not prove a request can complete.

panels.title: Live output · tokens/s
panels.description: Output across all streams, including active replies, over the latest scrape interval. Includes idle time and is not per-request decode speed.

panels.title: Running requests
panels.description: Current requests in prefill or decode. This counts requests, not TP ranks.

panels.title: Waiting requests
panels.description: Native queued/held requests. Does not expose queue-wait duration or failed requests.

panels.title: Shared cache pool used
panels.description: Occupied shared cache rows divided by pool capacity, including retained prompt states. This is separate from host memory usage.

panels.title: Output throughput
panels.description: Live output includes active replies; finished-request output books the whole reply at completion. The latest-interval trace shows bursts, while one-minute averages show the trend.

panels.title: Time to first token · completed requests
panels.description: Server arrival to first generated token, recorded at completion over five minutes. Coarse-bucket quantiles require 20 observations and none above 300 seconds.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, rate(tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host"}[5m])) and on(job,instance,model,recipe,runtime) (increase(tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host"}[5m]) >= 20) and on(job,instance,model,recipe,runtime) (increase(tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host",le="300"}[5m]) >= ignoring(le) increase(tensorfold:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host"}[5m]))) and on(job,instance,model,recipe,runtime) (up{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(up{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"$model",recipe=~"$recipe",instance=~"$serving_host"}) < 10))

panels.title: Request latency · completed requests
panels.description: Server arrival to reply completion over five minutes. Quantiles require 20 observations and none above 300 seconds; the mean includes all observations.

panels.title: Completed requests · last 5 minutes
panels.description: Finished latency observations over five minutes; extrapolation can produce fractional counts. Missing data means the scrape is unavailable.

panels.title: Concurrency and stream states
panels.description: Concurrent stream states and the current stream ceiling. Filling counts prefill activity, not HTTP requests.

panels.title: Prompt reuse · completed work
panels.description: Cached prompt tokens divided by all prompt tokens across finished requests over five minutes. No value without finished prompt accounting.

panels.title: Prompt throughput · completed work
panels.description: Prompt tokens book at request completion, not while prefill is running. Uncached input = prompt minus cached prompt tokens; neither is a live prefill-speed measurement.

panels.title: Speculative acceptance · completed work
panels.description: Accepted divided by drafted tokens across finished requests over five minutes. No value when no drafts were verified.

panels.title: Shared cache pool · tokens
panels.description: Cache pool capacity, occupied rows and free rows, including retained prompt states. This is separate from per-stream context occupancy.

panels.title: Retained prompts
panels.description: Retained prompt states can occupy the cache pool while idle.

panels.title: Context ceiling
panels.description: Effective per-request context ceiling reported by the running engine.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Inference metrics scrape duration, with an 800 ms timeout and one-second interval. The scrape makes no inference request.

options.content: A successful scrape does not prove a request can complete; client-visible latency, per-request decode speed, queue-wait duration and error/cancellation counts remain unmeasured. See the [monitoring runbook](https://github.com/kelchm/home-lab/blob/main/sparks/monitoring/README.md) for token accounting and histogram limits.
